theme: A day on the road south.
greeting: You're in Fredericksburg tonight, Dan — about halfway down I-95 with the family and the Pathfinder pointed at St. Pete. The calendar is empty but the drive, and a cottage is waiting Thursday.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: The task in Todoist you marked highest-priority — hold a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week — has been open since mid-September. Holiday inventory at PWM is the thinnest of the year, so a refundable booking now takes the whole risk off the table.

needsAttention.title: December break needs a destination
needsAttention.detail: The shortlist in Todoist was due Sept 30 and the Oct 15 booking window has slipped. Three weeks for six over the holidays books thin, so choosing domestic-or-international and locking dates is what unblocks the rest.

flagged.title: NACD New England run of show
flagged.detail: The New England chapter organizer circulated the agenda for next week's Oct 28 event — a directors' room worth arriving prepared for.

flagged.title: St. Pete cottage check-in Thursday
flagged.detail: The Coffee Pot Bayou Airbnb for Oct 22-Nov 2 is confirmed and the host wrote to welcome you — nothing owed, just the end of this drive.

inbox.noise: Thirty-odd retail and travel promotions — Tracksmith, Bialetti, Kayak, Indochino and the usual — plus a LinkedIn job alert and a couple of newsletters.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on a reply from you.

recipe.title: Kabocha squash pie
recipe.why: Autumn's winter squash is at its sweetest right now, so this is the season to let kabocha carry a pie.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike
Portland house order — bedframe + outdoor shower soap holder

acts.line: Wheels south on I-95 — the first long leg of the Portland-to-St. Pete run.
The mid-Atlantic middle, the stretch that's just miles and podcasts.
Checked in at the Spark by Hilton in Fredericksburg, Virginia — roughly the halfway mark.
